notes: Variant assumption is the supine EZ-bar skull crusher on a flat bench. Exact EZ-bar EMG was not found in the reviewed source set, so the movement uses lying barbell triceps press, lying elbow extension, and elbow-extension biomechanics evidence. The EZ-bar grip is treated as an implement variation that changes wrist/grip comfort more than the primary muscle role. Visible roles are intentionally limited to Triceps brachii.
